description: Starts a new DRAFT article ('Note') as the authenticated account. No input required. Returns the new article's entity id and its full article object. Requires an authenticated X session with write capability behind the API key. Cost: $0.0016 per call. Docs: https://docs.twitterapis.com/docs/reference/articles/article-create

auth_token.description: Optional. The account's auth_token cookie; together with ct0, this call acts as that account. Sent out of band: as the x-auth-token request header on most endpoints, or inside the JSON request body on endpoints that take one. It is not sent as a query parameter, so it does not reach a URL or an access log.

ct0.description: Optional. The account's ct0 cookie, paired with auth_token. Same transport as auth_token: the x-ct0 request header, or the JSON body on a body-taking endpoint. It is not sent as a query parameter.

proxy_url.description: Optional. Residential proxy URL this call egresses through. X soft-blocks writes from datacenter IPs as automated. Sent as the x-proxy-url request header, or in the JSON body on a body-taking endpoint.

user_agent.description: Optional. User-Agent string sent for this session. Sent as the x-user-agent request header, or in the JSON body on a body-taking endpoint.

name: twitter_article_create
